## DateTimeZone.FixedLocalNow

```m
DateTimeZone.FixedLocalNow() as datetimezone
```

Category: DateTimeZone · hosts: desktop

Returns the current date & time in the local timezone. This value is fixed and will not change with successive calls.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/datetimezone-fixedlocalnow)

## DateTimeZone.FixedUtcNow

```m
DateTimeZone.FixedUtcNow() as datetimezone
```

Category: DateTimeZone · hosts: desktop

Returns the current date and time in UTC (the GMT timezone). This value is fixed and will not change with successive calls.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/datetimezone-fixedutcnow)
